headlines.title: Nvidia stock pares morning losses after CEO Jensen Huang announces resignation
headlines.summary: Jensen Huang is out — full stop. The man who built Nvidia from a gaming chip shop into the central bank of AI is gone, and CFO Colette Kress is minding the store. This hits every corner of the tape: NVDA itself, the entire AI infrastructure complex, hyperscaler capex plans, and the $500 billion in AI debt financing that was underwritten on the assumption Huang was steering the ship. When the architect walks out the door, you reprice everything he touched.

headlines.title: Four tankers struck by explosions in Strait of Hormuz, Iran says
headlines.summary: Four tankers blown up in the Strait of Hormuz is not a drill — roughly 20% of global oil supply runs through that chokepoint, and Trump just told the world he doesn't need an Iran deal. Oil is bid hard, the long bond is getting hit on inflation fears, and energy names are screaming. This is the kind of headline that moves USO, XLE, and airline stocks all at once while the bond market reprices the Fed's next move.

headlines.title: Daly Says More Fed Rates Hikes Likely Needed
headlines.summary: San Francisco Fed's Daly is out there saying more hikes are coming, businesses are already thinking about raising prices, and a December move is now fully priced in per JPMorgan's desk. Hot CPI plus hawkish Fed speak plus a $404 billion October deficit is a nasty cocktail for rate-sensitive equities and the long bond. Utilities, REITs, and anything that borrowed cheap money are all in the crosshairs.
